default.advice: Please provide details about your mixed gas to get a preliminary assessment.

water_vapor.advice: Separating water from hydrogen is a standard process. The investment is generally low and ROI is very fast.

nitrogen.advice: A Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) system will likely be required. It's a proven technology with an excellent lifespan.

oxygen.advice: A Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) system will likely be required. It's a proven technology with an excellent lifespan.

carbon_dioxide.advice: These gases require specific membrane technologies or advanced PSA. The initial investment is higher, but recovering H₂ remains highly profitable at scale.

argon.advice: These gases require specific membrane technologies or advanced PSA. The initial investment is higher, but recovering H₂ remains highly profitable at scale.

mixed_unknown.advice: Our engineers will need to sample and analyze your exhaust gas to design a custom multi-stage separation process.

mixedGasType.label: Mixed Gas Type
mixedGasType.tooltip: Which gas is mixed with H₂ ?

annualMixedGasProduced.label: Annual Mixed Gas Produced
annualMixedGasProduced.tooltip: Gas volume normalized at 1 atm and 0°C (Nm³).

h2Concentration.label: H₂ Concentration in Exhaust Gas
h2Concentration.tooltip: Percentage of H₂ contained in the mixed gas stream before recovery.

currentH2PurchasePrice.label: Current Green H₂ Purchase Price
currentH2PurchasePrice.tooltip: The price you currently pay for delivered hydrogen. This serves as a baseline to calculate your potential savings with on-site recycling.

recyclingSystemPrice.label: Estimated Recycling System Price (CAPEX)
recyclingSystemPrice.tooltip: The estimation of the initial purchase cost (CAPEX).

maintenanceCosts.label: Maintenance costs (OPEX)
maintenanceCosts.tooltip: Annual operation and maintenance (O&M) costs, generally estimated as a percentage of the initial equipment cost (CAPEX).

energyConsumption.label: Recycling system energy consumption
energyConsumption.tooltip: Specific energy consumption of the recycling system itself to produce one kg of hydrogen. This value excludes system-wide auxiliaries like cooling or drying.

electricityPrice.label: Electricity price
electricityPrice.tooltip: The average grid electricity price. This is the primary cost driver for green hydrogen production.

cta.title: Want to Learn More?
cta.description: Hydrogen recycling systems are highly specific to the gas mixtures and processes involved. If you need more detailed information, research data, or want to discuss a specific use case, feel free to reach out.

step_mixed_gas_type.title: Mixed Gas Type
step_mixed_gas_type.content: Select the type of industrial exhaust gas containing hydrogen. This determines the complexity and the recycling technologies (PSA, EHC) required.

step_annual_mixed_gas.title: Annual Mixed Gas Volume
step_annual_mixed_gas.content: Enter the total volume of exhaust gas produced per year. This helps size the processing capacity of the recycling plant.

step_h2_concentration.title: H2 Concentration
step_h2_concentration.content: Specify the percentage of pure hydrogen present in the exhaust gas. A higher concentration improves recovery rates and profitability.

step_current_h2_price.title: Current H2 Purchase Price
step_current_h2_price.content: Enter the price at which you currently buy external hydrogen. This establishes the baseline for calculating your Return on Investment (ROI).

step_system_price.title: Recycling System CAPEX
step_system_price.content: Estimate the initial capital expenditure for the recycling system. This value is auto-calculated based on the gas type but can be adjusted manually.

step_maintenance_costs.title: Maintenance Costs
step_maintenance_costs.content: Set the annual operational and maintenance costs (OPEX) for the system, either as a flat fee (€) or a percentage of the initial CAPEX.

step_energy_consumption.title: Energy Consumption
step_energy_consumption.content: Indicate the energy required to recycle 1 kg of hydrogen. Complex purification systems like PSA will consume more energy.

step_electricity_price.title: Electricity Price
step_electricity_price.content: Enter the cost of your grid electricity. This directly impacts the operational costs of hydrogen recovery.
